summary: The sole-witness repair passes, but size and top-left diagonal sign predict all five delivered batch answers. This is a batch-selection defect; the broader generator produces counterexamples. Package files remained unchanged.

findings.description: Batch-selection defect: both 3×3 upper matrices have negative top-left entries (-9, -3), while both lower matrices have positive entries (9, 6). The sole 2×2 matrix is diagonal. Consequently, size plus one diagonal sign answers every delivered member without inspecting off-diagonal zeros. This rule succeeds on only 15/30 independent controls, so the finding is batch-specific.

findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python test_batch_shortcut.py. The strict acceptance test fails: choose Diagonal for 2×2; otherwise choose Upper when the top-left entry is negative and Lower otherwise. Accuracy is 5/5 after delivery filtering, with all five submissions accepted by the native grader. Flipping only the first record’s top-left value from -9 to 9 preserves Upper and causes the heuristic Lower response to be rejected.
